title: Fix strict-mode type errors surfaced by the tsconfig split (noUncheckedIndexedAccess + readonly violations)
resolution_note: Fixed strict-mode errors across src/core/domain/product-extractor.ts (7 hits), src/core/usecases/discovery-service.ts (buildPairs loop), src/core/domain/guide-builder.ts (readonly index signature — builder now uses a mutable Record internally), src/core/domain/levenshtein.ts (bounds-safe array access), src/adapters/primary/web-adapter.ts (regex group access + version sort), src/adapters/secondary/changelog-parser-adapter.ts (optional regex group), src/adapters/secondary/docusaurus-discovery-adapter.test.ts (fetch stub cast), tests/unit/product-extractor.test.ts (test fixture access). Added @domain/* path mapping to tsconfig.json so @domain/* imports resolve outside of Vite too. Result: tsc errors dropped from 35 (after the fwd-discovery delete) to 2. The remaining 2 are both in src/discovery-demo.ts which is uncommitted WIP on main — it imports createDiscoveryApp which doesn't exist (the real export is createDiscoveryAdapters). Left for the WIP author; captured as step-4 (out-of-scope) in this workplan.

done: wp-fix-tsconfig-tests-rootdir split the tsconfigs and surfaced errors that had been hidden behind TS6059 rootDir failures.

Three distinct buckets: (1) noUncheckedIndexedAccess in product-extractor + discovery-service, (2) readonly index signature writes in guide-builder, (3) uncommitted WIP in discovery-demo.ts referencing a non-existent createDiscoveryApp export.

steps.description: src/core/domain/product-extractor.ts — fix TS2345/TS2532 at lines 83, 89. Add non-null assertions or narrowing checks where index access is proven safe by the surrounding logic; otherwise push the optionality into the return type.
steps.done_condition: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json reports zero errors in this file

steps.description: src/core/usecases/discovery-service.ts — fix TS2532/TS2322 at lines 95-97. Current code reads discoveredVersions[i] without checking bounds. Either guard with length check or use .at(i) with a narrowing assertion.
steps.done_condition: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json reports zero errors in this file

steps.description: src/core/domain/guide-builder.ts — TS2542 at lines 74-92: writing to a readonly index signature on CodeExampleSet. Either relax the type (drop `readonly`) if mutation is intentional, or build a new object with spread rather than mutating in place.
steps.done_condition: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json reports zero errors in this file

steps.description: src/discovery-demo.ts is in uncommitted WIP on main (appears in `git status -s` as M). It imports `createDiscoveryApp` which does not exist in composition-root — the real export is `createDiscoveryAdapters`. This is a DO-NOT-TOUCH file per the uncommitted-WIP review (commit f4813a0's sibling analysis); defer fix to whoever authored the change or ask in #apidiff before proceeding.
steps.done_condition: either (a) author fixes the import + lands the WIP, OR (b) this step is reclassified as out-of-scope and closed
